description: Curated cigar notes from YouTube review corpus (original copy; not transcript paste). Human review before merge.

notes.hr: Cabinet Selection je Ashtonova klasična linija za mirniji stol — zreli habano pokrov, kremasta tekstura i blagi začini umjesto agresivne snage. Profil drži cedar i kavu u prvoj trećini, zatim malo kože i orašastih tonova. Dobar izbor kad želiš srednje tijelo i uredan, predvidiv draw bez iznenađenja.
notes.en: Cabinet Selection is Ashton’s classic line for a calmer session — aged habano wrapper, creamy texture and gentle spice rather than push. Cedar and coffee lead the first third, then a touch of leather and nut. A steady medium-bodied pick when you want a clean, predictable draw without fireworks.

notes.hr: Gran Puro naglašava puni habano karakter marke Punch — zemljani duhan, cedar i začinska toplina, s tijelom koje ne traži žurbu. Nije lagana Connecticut linija: očekuj srednju do punu snagu i duži dim. Najbolje kad imaš sat vremena i želiš okus koji drži rub kroz cijelu cigaru.
notes.en: Gran Puro leans into Punch’s full habano voice — earthy tobacco, cedar and warm spice, with a body that does not rush. This is not a mild Connecticut smoke: expect medium-to-full strength and a longer session. Best when you have an hour and want flavour that keeps an edge through the whole cigar.

notes.hr: Decade je Rocky Patelova linija za slavlje — tamniji pokrov, punije tijelo i slojevit profil: kakao, karamela, espresso i blagi papar u ravnoteži. Jača od klasičnog Connecticuta, ali bez grube grubosti. Dobra kad tražiš maduro karakter uz rum ili viski s toplijim notama.
notes.en: Decade is Rocky Patel’s celebratory line — darker wrapper, fuller body and layered flavour: cocoa, caramel, espresso and soft pepper in balance. Bigger than a classic Connecticut, but not rough. A strong pick when you want maduro character with a warmer rum or whisky.

notes.hr: Aniversario 10 je 1502-ova jubilarna linija s H-2000 pokrovom iz Nikaragve — srednje tijelo, uredan draw i topliji duhan nego kod blagih shade linija. Računaj na cedar i blagi začin bez pretjerane snage. Dobra kad želiš sat vremena i profil koji drži ritam kroz srednju trećinu.
notes.en: Aniversario 10 is 1502’s anniversary line with an H-2000 wrapper from Nicaragua — medium body, steady draw and warmer tobacco than mild shade lines. Expect cedar and soft spice without heavy nicotine push. A solid pick when you want an hour and a profile that keeps pace through the middle third.

notes.hr: Quattro Nicaragua ide punije — nikaragvanski pokrov, snaga oko petice i gustoća koja traži sporiji dim. Nije ulazna Connecticut večer: očekuj zemlju, kavu i začinski rub. Biraj je kad imaš vremena i piće koje podnese punije tijelo.
notes.en: Quattro Nicaragua leans full — Nicaraguan wrapper, strength near the top of the scale and density that wants a slower pace. Not an entry Connecticut evening: expect earth, coffee and a spicy edge. Choose it when you have time and a drink that can carry fuller body.

notes.hr: Ashton Classic je blaga dominikanska linija s Connecticut shade pokrovom — kremasta tekstura, niska snaga i predvidiv draw. Idealna za prvu cigaru za stolom ili za gosta koji ne želi nikotinski udar. Uz nju biraj lakše piće; maduro rum je lako nadjača.
notes.en: Ashton Classic is a mild Dominican line with a Connecticut shade wrapper — creamy texture, low strength and a predictable draw. Ideal as the first cigar at the table or for a guest who does not want a nicotine hit. Pair with a lighter drink; a maduro rum will easily overpower it.

notes.hr: Symmetry diže Ashton iznad Classic linije — habano pokrov, srednje tijelo i više začina uz i dalje urednu konstrukciju. Cedar i blaga koža drže srednju trećinu; snaga ostaje u granicama večere, ne tasting maratona. Dobar most kad Classic djeluje preblago.
notes.en: Symmetry lifts Ashton above the Classic line — habano wrapper, medium body and more spice while keeping tidy construction. Cedar and soft leather hold the middle third; strength stays dinner-table, not tasting-marathon. A good step up when Classic feels too mild.

notes.hr: Paso Doble iz Serie Signaturas nosi habano karakter na dominikanskoj osnovi — srednje tijelo, topliji duhan i začinski rub bez pune maduro težine. Draw obično ostaje uredan; format traži miran ritam dimova. Uklapa se uz rum ili viski srednje težine, ne uz lagani gin.
notes.en: Paso Doble from Serie Signaturas carries habano character on a Dominican base — medium body, warmer tobacco and a spicy edge without full maduro weight. Draw usually stays tidy; the format wants a calm puff rhythm. It fits a medium rum or whisky better than a light gin.

notes.hr: Camacho Connecticut nije najmekši shade na polici — honduraški blend drži malo više udarca nego tipični blagi Connecticut. Pokrov ostaje svijetli, ali tijelo i začin izlaze ranije. Dobra kad želiš Connecticut boju uz malo više ritma u dimu.
notes.en: Camacho Connecticut is not the softest shade on the shelf — the Honduran blend keeps a bit more kick than a typical mild Connecticut. The wrapper stays light, but body and spice show earlier. A good pick when you want Connecticut colour with a bit more rhythm in the smoke.

notes.hr: Camacho Corojo je markina jača referenca — corojo pokrov, punije tijelo i začinska toplina koja traži sporiji dim. Nije linija za brzi balkon: računaj na zemlju, papar i dulju sesiju. Najbolje uz piće koje podnese snagu, ne uz lagani highball.
notes.en: Camacho Corojo is the brand’s stronger reference — corojo wrapper, fuller body and spicy warmth that wants a slower pace. Not a quick balcony line: expect earth, pepper and a longer session. Best with a drink that can carry the strength, not a light highball.

notes.hr: Brazilia donosi brazilski maduro pokrov na nikaragvanskoj osnovi — srednje tijelo, tamnija slatkoća i toplina umjesto oštre snage. Kava i orašasti tonovi često vode; draw treba držati miran da se pokrov ne pregrije. Dobra večer uz rum s karamelom ili blagi maduro viski.
notes.en: Brazilia brings a Brazilian maduro wrapper over a Nicaraguan core — medium body, darker sweetness and warmth rather than sharp strength. Coffee and nutty tones often lead; keep the draw calm so the wrapper does not overheat. A good evening with a caramel-leaning rum or a gentle maduro whisky.

notes.hr: Davidoff Aniversario je mirna dominikanska linija s Connecticut pokrovom — srednje-blago tijelo, uredna konstrukcija i profil bez dramatičnih skokova. Cedar i kremasti duhan drže cijelu cigaru. Biraj je kad želiš eleganciju i vrijeme, ne kad tražiš puni maduro udar.
notes.en: Davidoff Aniversario is a calm Dominican line with a Connecticut wrapper — medium-mild body, tidy construction and a profile without dramatic jumps. Cedar and creamy tobacco hold through the cigar. Choose it when you want polish and time, not a full maduro punch.

notes.hr: Davidoff Nicaragua diže marku iznad Signature/Aniversario blagosti — habano pokrov, srednje tijelo i više zemlje uz i dalje uredan draw. Nije najjača nikaragvanska bomba, ali jasno jača od klasičnog Connecticuta. Dobra kad želiš Davidoff urednost s malo više karaktera.
notes.en: Davidoff Nicaragua lifts the brand above Signature/Aniversario mildness — habano wrapper, medium body and more earth while keeping a tidy draw. Not the loudest Nicaraguan bomb, but clearly stronger than classic Connecticut. A good pick when you want Davidoff polish with a bit more character.

notes.hr: Signature je Davidoffova najmirnija ulazna linija — lagana snaga, ekvadorski shade i predvidiv, čist dim. Profil ostaje kremast i kratak na začinu; idealna za gosta ili kratki format prije jače večeri. Ne forsiraš je uz overproof rum.
notes.en: Signature is Davidoff’s calmest entry line — low strength, Ecuadorian shade and a clean, predictable smoke. The profile stays creamy and light on spice; ideal for a guest or a short format before a stronger evening. Do not force it against an overproof rum.

notes.hr: Cactus Wren je Blackbirdova maduro linija na dominikanskoj osnovi — srednje-blago tijelo, tamniji pokrov i mekša slatkoća nego kod punih nikaragvanskih madura. Draw obično ostaje otvoren; ritam dimova neka bude sporiji u zadnjoj trećini. Uklapa se uz rum s vanilijom, ne uz vrlo suh viski.
notes.en: Cactus Wren is Blackbird’s maduro line on a Dominican base — medium-mild body, darker wrapper and softer sweetness than full Nicaraguan maduros. Draw usually stays open; keep the puff rhythm slower in the final third. It fits a vanilla-leaning rum better than a very dry whisky.

notes.hr: Session (CAO) ide s Connecticut shade pokrovom iz Nikaragva — srednje tijelo i uredan ritam dimova. Profil tipično drži kremasti duhan i blagi cedar umjesto oštrog začina. Dobra kad želiš sat vremena i profil koji drži srednju trećinu.
notes.en: Session (CAO) takes a Connecticut shade wrapper from Nikaragva — medium body and a steady puff rhythm. The profile typically holds creamy tobacco and soft cedar rather than sharp spice. A solid pick when you want an hour and a profile that holds the middle third.
